'''Aduba-6''' was the sixth and outermost [[Planet/Legends|planet]] orbiting the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Aduba (star)|Aduba]] in the [[Aduba system/Legends|Aduba system]],<ref name="GC" /> located in the [[Bheriz sector/Legends|Bheriz sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Aduba-6 was an [[Water/Legends|ice]] ball with one [[Moon/Legends|moon]].<ref name="GC" />

[[Tomb of Vaius Antinus's apprentice|The tomb]] of an [[Vaius Antinus's apprentice|apprentice]] of [[Vaius Antinus]] was located on the planet. At some point during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], [[Auselio Gann]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith]] [[Imperial Reclamation Service]] visited the tomb. Before leaving for Aduba-6, Gann sent a coded message to his protégé, [[Talos Drellik]]. In the tomb, Gann confronted [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] who were also trying to uncover the tomb's secrets and imprisoned himself in the process of turning the tomb's traps against them.<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
All worlds in the [[Aduba system/Legends|Aduba system]], except [[Aduba-3/Legends|Aduba-3]], were designed for the article ''[[The Starhoppers of Aduba-3]]'', published in the [[2001]] magazine [[Star Wars Gamer 4|''Star Wars Gamer'' 4]], which provided information for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GC" /> Later, the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], placed the Aduba star system in grid square U-11.<ref name="EAOC" />
